FROM honor_application a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = COALESCE(a.counselor_id, sp.counselor_id) LEFT JOIN honor_batch b ON b.id = a.batch_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO honor_application (batch_id, student_id, honor_type, academic_year, self_statement, honors_text, scholarships_text, pe_score, no_fail_declared, no_violation_declared, material_note, contact_phone, status, reject_reason, counselor_id, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{honorType}, #{academicYear}, #{selfStatement}, #{honorsText}, #{scholarshipsText}, #{peScore}, #{noFailDeclared}, #{noViolationDeclared}, #{materialNote}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{counselorId}, #{submittedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.batch_id = #{batchId} AND a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS studentName, RIGHT(COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id), 4) AS studentNoTail, a.honor_type AS honorType, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS className, COALESCE(sp.major, u.major) AS major FROM honor_application a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.batch_id = #{batchId} AND a.status IN ('publicized', 'awarded') ORDER BY className, studentNoTail

mapper.update: UPDATE honor_application SET honor_type = #{application.honorType}, academic_year = #{application.academicYear}, self_statement = #{application.selfStatement}, honors_text = #{application.honorsText}, scholarships_text = #{application.scholarshipsText}, pe_score = #{application.peScore}, no_fail_declared = #{application.noFailDeclared}, no_violation_declared = #{application.noViolationDeclared}, material_note = #{application.materialNote}, contact_phone = #{application.contactPhone}, status = 'submitted', reject_reason = NULL, counselor_id = #{application.counselorId}, submitted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{application.id} AND student_id = #{application.studentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE honor_application SET status = #{toStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE honor_application SET status = 'publicized', updated_at = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'dept_approved'
UPDATE honor_application SET status = 'awarded', updated_at = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'publicized'
